trap.label: adjetivo + preposição + -ing
trap.wrong: He is interested to build. She is good in fix. I am afraid to fail.
trap.right: He is interested in building. She is good at fixing. I am afraid of failing.
trap.why: Em português “interessado em construir”, “bom em consertar” e “medo de falhar” usam infinitivo após preposição. Em inglês, após preposição vem -ing e a preposição muda (in, at, of).

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She likes cooking and is good at it.” (good at cook)
Reescreva com interested: “He wants to know about painting.”
